changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cmr_feedback ADD COLUMN entry_type VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'mismatch/zero' AFTER type, ADD COLUMN source_task_no VARCHAR(32) COMMENT '来源任务号' AFTER search_id, ADD COLUMN source_query VARCHAR(1024) COMMENT '来源搜索词', ADD COLUMN mismatch_items_json JSON COMMENT '勾选的不匹配条目 [{itemId,name,score}]', ADD COLUMN judgment VARCHAR(32) COMMENT '处理判断 data_bad/match_bad/need_data', ADD COLUMN disposition VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'block/strategy/supplement', ADD COLUMN blocked TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '是否已写屏蔽';

changeSet.author: cmr

not.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmr_feedback WHERE entry_type IS NULL AND type IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cmr_blocked_item ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '被屏蔽条目 ID', item_name VARCHAR(512) COMMENT '条目名称', source VARCHAR(256) COMMENT '来源名', reason VARCHAR(512) COMMENT '屏蔽原因', feedback_id BIGINT COMMENT '来源反馈单', create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F', KEY idx_item (item_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 条目屏蔽';
